request.question: What happened at this body's meeting on 2026-07-28?

expectedRecords.text: Meanwhile's plain-language summary of the source record: Per the Board's posted meeting-summary report (full minutes post after approval): the Board appointed Jorge Soto as Pima County Treasurer (4–1, one abstention) after a first motion for a different candidate died without a second. It removed all five members of the county's Industrial Development Authority board without cause, approved a new structure for that authority, and elected new members. It also approved the River Overlook rezoning and comprehensive-plan amendment on West River Road (5–0) and two cell-tower permits, updated the county's air-quality code to match current federal rules, denied a wholesale liquor license on East Cabeza De Vaca Street (zoning there does not allow wholesale), and — sitting as the Library District board — accepted a $7,500 grant for a local-news pilot program (4–1), among other business.

expectedRecords.text: Meanwhile's plain-language summary of the source record: The Board approved the minutes of its July 8 meetings and three permission requests, including street closings for Boonton's Labor Day parade.
